summary: Frontend-only E2E test of Cloud OA Analysis (/app/analyze) — all 7 scenarios PASSED. Login OK, health badge shows 'API Connected' after /api/oa/health succeeds, Retry re-checks without crash, patient select works (5 patients listed), CSV of 45 rows averaged to 3 samples (ceil(45/20)=3), Analyze button shows loading then displays graceful analyze-error box containing upstream Windows-path 500 message (expected behavior — upstream Render API bug, not our app's). Session tab shows friendly toast 'No recent BLE/simulator session found. Capture data in AI Screening first.' Regression pages (dashboard/patients/screening/movement) all load.
critical_code_review_comments: No app-side bugs found. External Render /analyze endpoint has a hardcoded Windows path ('C:\OA SENTINEL\OUTPUT\camera_results.csv') causing consistent 500s — cannot be fixed here; already surfaced gracefully via analyze-error box.

OASentinel.js maps flexible response keys via pick() which is good for schema drift; consider adding a data-testid on the loading spinner button state for finer-grained testing (currently only text changes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: External Render /analyze always returns success:false with Windows path error — this is EXPECTED. The app must show analyze-error box with the upstream message. Do NOT report as bug. Login button label is 'Log in' (lowercase 'in'), not 'Sign In'. CSV averaging: 45 rows -> 3 samples via averageEvery(rows,20).
